articles.title: Analyst sees ’opportunity to invest at a very attractive valuation’ in this stock
articles.mainIdea: Analyst sees ’opportunity to invest at a very attractive valuation’ in this stock
articles.summary: Investing.com: Analyst sees ’opportunity to invest at a very attractive valuation’ in this stock. Investing.com -- Raymond James analyst Ric Prentiss on Wednesday upgraded Walt Disney shares to Outperform from Market Perform, setting a price target of $115, saying the current macro backdrop and international visitation headwinds represent "an opportunity to invest at a very attractive valuation."
